handback.t:
## W3 report: ruflo SONA ported and benchmarked. No SONA variant passes the bar. Faithful SONA is a keyword router with lock-in (about 0.014 below keyword) and has no exploration.

### 1. What SONA does today (installed ruflo CLI build)
Source: `C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\npm-cache\_npx\2ed56890c96f58f7\node_modules\@claude-flow\cli\dist\src\`. I did not modify anything there.

**Pattern memory** (`memory/sona-optimizer.js`)
- Patterns are keyed `agent:sortedKeywords` (L527-530) and created at confidence 0.5 (L213-222).
- Update (L224-233, constants L21-28): success gives `c += 0.1*(1-c)` capped at 0.99. Failure gives `c -= 0.15*c` floored at 0.1.
- Only the agent that actually ran gets a pattern.
- Pruning: above 1000 patterns, keep 800 by `confidence*recency` (L613-630).
- Persistence is to `.swarm/sona-patterns.json` (L647-713).

**Routing** (`getRoutingSuggestion`, L275-355), in priority order:
1. Native `@ruvector/sona` engine (L277-300). **Dead code in this build.** The call `new SonaEngine({mode:'real-time'})` (L146) does not match the constructor `constructor(hiddenDim: number)` in `@ruvector/sona/index.d.ts`. I ran it under node: it throws a napi u32 conversion error, which is caught and leaves `sonaEngine = null`. `findPatterns` also expects an embedding array, not a string.
2. Best learned pattern if `confidence*matchRatio >= 0.6` (L303-313). `findBestPatternMatch` (L534-555) scores `|matched|/max(|pattern kw|,|task kw|) * conf`, requires at least 1 matched keyword, and ties go to the earliest-inserted pattern.
3. Q-learning router (L315-331), only if its softmax confidence is at least 0.5.
4. Static keyword-category heuristic (`matchKeywordsToAgent`, L559-589).
5. Default `'coder'`.

**Q-learner** (`ruvector/q-learning-router.js`)
- lr 0.1, terminal updates, reward +1 / -0.5 (sona L243), 8 actions, prioritized replay of 32 from a 1000 buffer (L402-440), LRU route cache.
- `route(task, false)` means no exploration.
- Reaching softmax confidence 0.5 over 8 actions needs a Q gap of about ln 7. Rewards are capped at +1 and failures are -0.5, so this stage essentially never fires.

**Other "SONA" things in ruflo**
- `LocalSonaCoordinator` (`memory/intelligence.js` L80-200) records trajectories and nudges ReasoningBank pattern confidence by reward*0.1. It does not select agents.
- `ruvllm_sona_create/adapt` (`mcp-tools/ruvllm-tools.js` L170-215) is an instant-adaptation loop driven by a quality scalar. It does no routing.
- The only caller of `processTrajectoryOutcome` is `hooks_intelligence_trajectory-end` (`mcp-tools/hooks-tools.js` L3166-3180).
- `getRoutingSuggestion` has no internal caller in the CLI dist. It is only exported (`index.js` L628).
- The marketplace skill doc (`.agents/skills/agent-sona-learning-optimizer/SKILL.md`) claims "+55% max quality" and "+5% code quality". I found no routing evidence for either.

**Structural facts that decide the benchmark**
- There is no exploration anywhere in the routing path.
- A pattern must clear 0.6 confidence, which takes 3 straight successes from 0.5 or a success rate of roughly 0.7 or more. Otherwise routing falls through to the static keyword heuristic.
- A trap keyword's agent therefore keeps getting chosen forever. This is the failure mode I'd want you to know about before wiring SONA anywhere.

### 2. Port:
[...]
ig::default()` is the faithful port. It carries the Q-learner port, route cache, replay, pruning and the stage priorities. A `src: [u64;6]` counter reports which stage made each selection.

Deviations, all documented in the module header:
- Text keyword extraction is replaced by `Task::features` (deduplicated, first 10 kept).
- `KEYWORD_CATEGORIES` becomes the sim's keyword-to-agent map, with the heuristic scoring `matched/|category|`.
- The Q state key is the sorted feature set. The JS hashes substring presence of 32 English words, which would collapse the opaque sim keywords into one state, so mine is more discriminating than the original and generous to SONA.
- Recency, cache TTL and temporal decay use a logical clock or are ignored.
- Q actions outside `candidates` fall through to the keyword heuristic.
- `reward >= 0.5` maps to JS `success`.
- Priority 1 is not ported because it is dead code.

Opt-in additions that are NOT in ruflo, all off by default:
- `explore_eps`: uniform random choice with that probability.
- `explore_untried`: with that probability, pick uniformly among candidates still unproven (no pattern, or confidence below threshold).
- `per_feature`: one pattern per (keyword, agent) instead of per exact keyword set.

Six unit tests in `sona.rs`: cold start equals the keyword heuristic, JS confidence constants, 3-success lock-in, never-explores-by-default, untried escapes a trap, prune cap.

### 3. Benchmark
Run `cargo run --release --bin w3_sona [-- --out results/w3_sona.json]`. It takes about 20 s once built.

Protocol, same as shortlab:
- World generator copied verbatim from `shortlab.rs`.
- Tuning on seeds 1-8 only; objective is mean of H=100/250/500.
- Evaluation on held-out seeds 31-60.
- Paired 95% t-CI; Holm over candidates x horizons against the best fair baseline per horizon.
- Baselines (re-tuned by the same procedure, and they reproduce `shortlab.json`): keyword, eps-greedy(0.95, 0.02), pooled-ts(1.0), hebbian-robust, warm(hebbian-robust) = WarmHebR(k=1, Mean).

Held-out means (all rows ±95% CI, 30 seeds):

| router | H=100 | H=250 | H=500 | H=1000 | H=2000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| keyword | 0.667 | 0.656 | 0.656 | 0.654 | 0.654 |
| hebbian-robust | 0.564 | 0.647 | 0.706 | 0.751 | 0.773 |
| warm(hebbian-robust) | 0.651 | 0.692 | 0.732 | 0.762 | 0.778 |
| **sona (faithful, Q on)** | 0.651 | 0.642 | 0.640 | 0.640 | 0.640 |
| sona (faithful, Q off) | 0.651 | 0.642 | 0.640 | 0.640 | 0.640 |
| sona threshold-tuned | 0.651 | 0.642 | 0.640 | 0.644 | 0.649 |
| sona+eps | 0.648 | 0.637 | 0.635 | 0.635 | 0.636 |
| sona+untried | 0.645 | 0.637 | 0.637 | 0.642 | 0.651 |
| sona-feature(+explore) | 0.640 | 0.656 | 0.683 | 0.720 | 0.749 |
| warm(sona-feature) | 0.662 | 0.667 | 0.688 | 0.715 | 0.742 |

The best fair baseline is keyword at H=100 and warm(hebbian-robust) at H>=250.

**Faithful SONA vs the best fair baseline** (mean diff [95% CI], seed wins/losses, Holm p):

| horizon | best baseline | diff | CI | W/L | Holm p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H=100 | keyword | -0.0159 | [-0.0256, -0.0062] | 7/23 | 0.0135 |
| H=250 | warm(hebbian-robust) | -0.0498 | [-0.0666, -0.0330] | 5/25 | <0.0001 |
| H=500 | warm(hebbian-robust) | -0.0920 | [-0.1070, -0.0771] | 0/30 | <0.0001 |
| H=1000 | warm(hebbian-robust) | -0.1227 | [-0.1346, -0.1109] | 0/30 | <0.0001 |
| H=2000 | warm(hebbian-robust) | -0.1379 | [-0.1486, -0.1272] | 0/30 | <0.0001 |

- **Versus keyword:** faithful SONA is significantly worse than keyword at every horizon (-0.013 to -0.016, Holm p 0.008 to 0.035). It is mostly keyword with some lock-in noise.
- **Where its selections come from** (mean over seeds 31-60, faithful, 2000 tasks):

| stage | share of selections |
|---|---|
| learned pattern | 38.4% |
| keyword heuristic | 60.6% |
| default | 1.0% |
| Q-learning | 0.0% |

  About 421 patterns are stored per run. The 0.0% Q-learning share confirms the analysis above.
- **Best variant:** sona-feature(+explore), tuned `threshold 0.5, eps 0.02, untried 0.1, per_feature`. It does beat keyword from H=500 on (+0.028 at H=500, +0.095 at H=2000, both Holm p<0.01). But it loses to warm(hebbian-robust) at every horizon:

| horizon | diff vs warm(hebbian-robust) | CI | Holm p |
|---|---|---|---|
| H=250 | -0.036 | [-0.056, -0.016] | 0.007 |
| H=500 | -0.0485 | [-0.0662, -0.0309] | <0.0001 |
| H=1000 | -0.042 | not extracted | <0.0001 |
| H=2000 | -0.0288 | [-0.0365, -0.0211] | <0.0001 |

  At H=2000 it wins 0 of 30 seeds. At H=100 it is -0.027 versus keyword (Holm p 0.0004).

### 4. Accept / reject
**ACCEPTED: none.** The lab prints `ACCEPTED ... : []`.

| idea | outcome |
|---|---|
| Faithful SONA | Rejected. Worse than keyword, much worse than the learned baselines. |
| Tune threshold and Q on/off (seeds 1-8) | Rejected. Tuned to threshold 0.5 with Q on, and gains only +0.009 over faithful at H=2000, still below keyword. |
| Uniform epsilon over the pattern layer (tuned eps 0.02, thr 0.6, no Q) | Rejected. Slightly worse than faithful. |
| "Unproven agent" exploration (tuned thr 0.55, p 0.05, no Q) | Rejected. About keyword level. |
| Per-keyword patterns plus exploration | Rejected. Learns, but loses to warm(hebbian-robust) at every horizon. |
| Warm hand-over of per-feature SONA to the keyword map (tuned k=1, FailMean) | Rejected. At H=500 it is -0.040 [-0.052, -0.027] against warm(hebbian-robust). |

My read: the useful learning structure in the sim is per-feature credit plus a keyword prior with a learned hand-over, and the existing warm(hebbian-robust) already does that. SONA's components add nothing to it, so I did not push further on SONA improvements.

### 5. Reproduce, files, tests
- Command: `cargo run --release --bin w3_sona` (output `results/w3_sona.json`). It needs the crate to compile, and `mesh.rs` was mid-edit by another worker early on. During that window I ran the same lab from a private snapshot dir, `C:\Users\mariu\nm-w3-snap` (an identical copy of the used modules plus `w3_sona.rs`). The real-crate rerun produced identical numbers. I could not delete that snapshot because the harness blocked `rm -rf`, so it is leftover scratch space.
- Files I created: `src/sona.rs`, `src/bin/w3_sona.rs`, `results/w3_sona.json`.
- I added `pub mod sona;` to `src/lib.rs` (that line only).
- I changed nothing else.
- `cargo test --release --lib` on the real crate: **46 passed, 0 failed**.
- No git commits made.

### 6. Caveats
- The sim keywords are opaque ids, not English text, so SONA's real-world keyword extraction and its English `KEYWORD_CATEGORIES` heuristic are untested here.
- This is the simulated routing world only; nothing was measured on real ruflo traffic.
